name: How to Resize a PDF for Printing
description: Fit any PDF to A4, Letter, Legal, A3, or A5 for printing — free, no upload required.

step.name: Open your PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose files' or drag your PDF into the drop zone.

step.name: Pick a paper size and fit mode
step.text: Choose A4, Letter, Legal, A3, or A5, then choose Fit, Fill, or Actual size. The live preview shows the exact scale before you commit.

step.name: Download and print with confidence
step.text: Click 'Resize PDF'. Every page is rebuilt at the target paper size and ready to download instantly.
